bm_desc: ASIL : 16-Feb-2026 :  The Company has informed the Exchange that a Board meeting was held today on February 14, 2026 and it has been adjourned due to non completion of Limited Review Procedure. Further, the Company has informed the Exchange that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company will be held on February 16, 2026,  To consider and approve the financial results for the period ended December 31, 2025
To consider other business matters

To consider and approve the Audited Standalone Financial Results along with Audit Report for the period ended December 31, 2025 for the purpose of submission of Networth Certificate to comply with regulatory requirements and other business matters.
To consider and approve the modifications in terms and conditions of Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs)
To consider and approve the financial results for the period ended December 31, 2025
To consider and approve inter alia, the proposal of fund raise by way of issuance of equity shares through Rights Issue.
